name: AILoadingIndicator
description: Thinking, working and retrieving indicators. Each announces its status as text through a polite live region; animation is never the only signal.
intent: Say that the machine is working, truthfully.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: variant
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: label
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: size
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: The label is the accessible signal. Animation is decorative and aria-hidden.
All animation carries motion-reduce:animate-none, so the text still communicates under reduced motion.
Unmount it when the work finishes and announce the result — a live region that simply disappears says nothing.

agentRules: Must track real in-flight work. Never animate to simulate effort.
Announce the outcome when it unmounts.
Use ai:ai-progress when the total is known.
